change: Single-definition perturbation: none. None of the 10 variable definitions is changed.
Single-definition perturbation: world frame. The world frame is right-handed: Xw is axial and points forward, Yw is normal and points up, and Zw is lateral and points right.
Single-definition perturbation: object frame. The object frame is right-handed: Xb is axial and points forward, Yb is normal and points up, and Zb is lateral and points right.
Single-definition perturbation: camera-1 frame. The camera-1 frame is right-handed: X1 is axial and points forward, Y1 is normal and points up, and Z1 is lateral and points right.

Single-definition perturbation: camera azimuth. Camera azimuth is positive when the optical axis deflects to the left of the world.
Single-definition perturbation: camera pitch. Camera pitch is positive when the optical axis deflects downward in the world.
Single-definition perturbation: camera roll. Camera roll is positive when the right edge of the image deflects upward in the camera.
Single-definition perturbation: mechanism pitch. Mechanism pitch is positive when the object axis deflects downward in the world.
Single-definition perturbation: mechanism azimuth. Mechanism azimuth is positive when the object axis deflects to the right of the world.
